verdict.rationale: Sentry records cost and token usage per LLM call and per trace. It groups AI spans into sessions with `set_conversation_id()` and shows user identity in the Conversations view, and span-based dashboard widgets can be built from Trace Explorer queries. The docs never show cost broken down by user, session, or feature, or tagging spans with arbitrary custom metadata for cost attribution. Missing for 10: documented custom metadata or attributes for feature-level attribution, explicit per-user and per-session cost aggregation views, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance without reviewing an entire conversation or trace.
Below these widgets is a traces table showing trace ID, agents, root duration, errors, LLM calls, tool calls, total tokens, total cost, and timestamp.
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
Any of `id`, `email`, or `username` is sufficient — the Conversations tab displays whichever fields are present.
You can create span-based widgets directly from [Trace Explorer](/product/trace-explorer/) queries using the "Save As" button.
